install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-1b8d94f2afe8c2c0a8bd，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-ding 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。对话完成提醒：Agent 空闲（idle）时播放提示音并弹 Windows 原生通知，可配 ding.mp3、音量与防抖节流。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1b8d94f2afe8c2c0a8bd.html
posts.en:
dsh-ding is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1b8d94f2afe8c2c0a8bd.html
